text: Charming 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom Craftsman in Portland's SE Hawthorne district. Built in 2012. Recently remodeled kitchen with quartz counters and shaker cabinets. Hardwood floors throughout the main level. Detached 1-car garage. Fenced backyard with mature landscaping. Appraisal draws on three nearby comps with similar square footage and year built.

Three bedroom, two bathroom Craftsman-influenced home in NE Portland's Laurelhurst edge. Built in 2014. Open floor plan with hardwood floors and a renovated kitchen featuring quartz counters. Single-car garage. Landscaped backyard. Appraised using three comparable sales within one mile, all built between 2010 and 2015.

Four bedroom, three bathroom traditional two-story in Seattle's Madison Park. Built in 1998, extensively updated 2019. Territorial view of Lake Washington. Finished basement with media room. Two-car attached garage. Appraisal uses three high-end comps reflecting the neighborhood premium.

One bedroom, one bathroom condominium in Portland's Pearl District. Built in 2008. Floor-to-ceiling windows with city views. Building amenities include fitness center and rooftop deck. No parking space included; paid street parking nearby.

Two bedroom, one bathroom bungalow in Portland's St Johns neighborhood. Built in 1942, cosmetic updates 2020. Original hardwood floors under carpet per disclosure. Detached single-car garage. Deep lot with alley access. Appraisal notes limited comparable inventory in the immediate area.

Three bedroom, two bathroom Cape Cod in Portland's Beaumont-Wilshire. Built in 1948, addition in 2011. Updated kitchen and primary bath. Two-car garage with workshop space. Mature landscaping with drip irrigation. Appraisal based on three Cape Cod / Tudor-influenced comps in Beaumont.

Four bedroom, two and a half bathroom contemporary in Happy Valley. Built in 2018. Open great room, gourmet kitchen with gas range and island seating. Primary suite on main level. Two-car attached garage. Covered back patio. HOA covers common area landscaping.

Three bedroom, two bathroom modern row home in Portland's Eliot neighborhood. Built in 2013. Three levels with rooftop deck. Quartz counters and hardwood floors. Tandem two-car garage. Small fenced patio. Appraised using three similar row-home comps built between 2012 and 2016.
